caption:
Your old customers are worth more than your next lead.

Example workflow, not a client account.

Most shops spend their entire ad budget chasing strangers and never touch the list of people who already paid them once. A dormant-customer win-back sequence fixes that without adding work for your team:

1. Pull everyone with no job in 12+ months.
2. Day 1: text asking if they need service again.
3. Day 4: no reply triggers an email with a seasonal reason to book.
4. Day 10: one last text, then a 6-month re-check instead of a dead file.

See it running on your own list. 14 days free.
